en.headline: 23 commits across 3 repos; deepseek and minimax tuning plus MV3 skeleton
en.summary: On 2026-10-22 the user pushed **23 own commits** across three repositories, plus 27 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 13 own commits centered on measuring `reasoning_effort` behavior: documenting deepseek's three `reasoning_effort` settings and their measured usage, switching minimax's free leg to `reasoning_effort=low` after `none` returned 400 and omitting the parameter led to thinking timeouts, and running several temporary CI probes (rounds two through five, an A/B test, and an end-to-end run) that were later deleted. A codemap baseline was also repointed to the rebased `d93ea4d` because the original `9cc6516` is no longer in main history. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 7 commits built an MV3 skeleton, dropped selection translation in favor of page translation, added `AGENTS.md`, `checkJs` type checking via JSDoc, page-state reset between runs with required-field validation and a DOM smoke test for two-round restore, and finalized the development plan. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 3 commits documented OMO slim: a full table of the 11 bundled skills and their authorization targets, three new behavior-constraint skills in v3.0.5, and a new `openchamber-storage` category covering pasted-image storage, deletion without shrinking, and the VACUUM flow.

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 23 次提交：deepseek 与 minimax 调参、MV3 骨架
zh.summary: 2026-10-22，用户共提交 **23 次本人提交**，涉及三个仓库，另有 27 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，13 次提交主要围绕 `reasoning_effort` 的实测：记录 deepseek 三种 `reasoning_effort` 取值及其实测用量，在 `none` 会返回 400、去掉参数又会思考超时的情况下，将 minimax 免费腿改为发送 `reasoning_effort=low`，并运行了多轮临时 CI 探针（第二至第五轮、A/B 测试及真实链端到端），用完后删除。codemap 映射基线也改指向 rebase 后的 `d93ea4d`，因为原 `9cc6516` 已不在 main 历史中。在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 中，7 次提交搭建 MV3 骨架，去掉划词翻译只保留整页翻译，新增 `AGENTS.md`、通过 JSDoc 实现的 `checkJs` 类型检查、每次翻译间重置页面状态并加入必填字段校验与两轮恢复的 DOM 冒烟测试，并完成最终开发计划。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，3 次提交补充 OMO slim 文档：随包 11 个 skill 的全表及授权对象、v3.0.5 新增的三个行为约束型 skill，以及新的 `openchamber-storage` 类别（粘贴图片存文件还是落库、删除不缩与 VACUUM 流程）。用户还在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 issue #8（`[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败`）下发表了评论，该 issue 共 5 条评论。当天没有 PR、评审或发布；另外观察到一处外部状态变更：`btriapitsyn` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的项目操作菜单相关 issue #5293。
